0x0007FC.en: 「This is all I've got...@　the end of the line...!」

0x0008F5.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x00096F.en: 「So this is... as far as I go...?」

0x000A56.en: 「Well, well...@　not my finest moment, is it!」

0x000B1F.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000B5A.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　Not funny...」

0x000BAE.en: 「Messed up...!@　Guess I have to bail...」

0x000C22.en: 「Ngh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000CFF.en: 「So this is it... the rest is up to you.」

0x000D31.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is the end!」

0x000D6D.en: 「Ngh! Guess they got the jump on me...」

0x000DAB.en: 「No good, we took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000DF8.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E36.en: 「Eek! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E7D.en: 「The Granzon... shot down, of all things...」

0x000F28.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the falling star this time... Ejecting!」

0x0010D1.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001118.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x00114D.en: 「Damn! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001239.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I've still got a lot to learn...!」

0x001287.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Pulling back!」

0x001300.en: 「Sorry, guys!@ I'm gonna have to bow out...!」

0x001342.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x001371.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013AF.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0013DE.en: 「I can't manage any more. Do excuse me.」

0x001469.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll have to pull back...!」

0x0015CF.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! So much for looking cool...」

0x0017FC.en: 「So I've still got a ways to go...!」

0x00193A.en: 「Nah, I'm just glad we linked up with the Hiryu Kai.@ Coffee here beats anything you'd get at some@ hole-in-the-wall cafe.」

0x0019D3.en: 「Yes... it's nice, having a place you can@ come back to.」

0x001A23.en: 「Honestly, that crew was@ a bit much to handle.」

0x001A7D.en: 「First, you got two guys and one beast, all@ stiff and buttoned-up. Then two girls - tomboys@ if you're nice about it, crude if you're not...」

0x001B25.en: 「Just no comfort in it at all, y'know?@ I was parched, seriously. Any longer and you'd@ have ended up being my only comfort.」

0x001BDD.en: 「Meeting Captain Lefina, that's when I finally felt some relief.@ Aah, can't wait to see Leona already.」

0x001C6C.en: (Uh, if anything, I wouldn't call Ensign Leona@ the comforting type...@ Hm? Hold on.)

0x001CDB.en: 「Say, Ensign Tasuku.@ About what you just said, you forgot someone.」

0x001DED.en: 「Oh, right, I felt like I'd seen Mister Gennacy@ somewhere before, so I looked him up@ in the database, and...」

0x001E8F.en: 「Turns out he was a competitive swimmer.@ An Olympic gold medalist, no less.」

0x001F37.en: 「I am. Just to be sure,@ I confirmed it with the man himself.」

0x001FB2.en: 「Yes... truth is, Mister Gennacy and I@ get along pretty well...」

0x00200E.en: (Wh-when did that even happen...!@ Heck, I didn't even notice@ the two of them were talking.)

0x00208C.en: 「Prince Feil is alive...!?@ Is that true!?」

0x002120.en: 「I can't say why, but...@ I'm certain of it. Masaki aside,@ Tytti may be traveling with the prince.」

0x0021D7.en: 「If it's true about Prince Feil...@ then why is General Kirkus hiding it from us?」

0x00225A.en: 「He must not want us to know right now.@　Perhaps the general is...」

0x0022CC.en: 「No... I'd rather it just be my imagination.」

0x00235A.en: 「Yeah, Captain Lefina's calling for you.@ Says she wants to hear about General Kirkus.」

0x002437.en: 「Yes. Until this war broke out, that's what@ they called General Kirkus.」

0x00249F.en: 「But after the terror attack in the royal capital@ and the Shutedonias invasion began,@ he rose to prominence.」

0x00252F.en: 「He led his own forces into a counterattack...@ and went so far as to retake Troia State.」

0x0025B6.en: 「Hmm... a late bloomer whose talent finally opened up,@ or a mask that's finally slipped. Which is it, I wonder.」

0x002639.en: 「Either way, there's no question that Kirkus's@ army is at the very forefront of@ liberating Langran.」

0x0026BD.en: 「Understood. We'll reach Troia State shortly.@ Let's meet General Kirkus in person@ and judge his character for ourselves.」

0x002796.en: 「...General Kirkus,@ I've brought the captain of the Hiryu Kai.」

0x00280B.en: 「Earth Federation Far East Command, 1st@ Independent Special Task Force... Steel Dragon@ commander, Hiryu Kai captain, Colonel Enfield.」

0x0028C2.en: 「I'm grateful you came all this way.@ I am Kirkus Zan Valfarbia.@ For now, I serve as Langran's representative.」

0x00296A.en: (Representative, is it...?@ And to think Prince Feil is still alive...)

0x0029C9.en: 「Let me again thank you for aiding Yang Long and the others.@ We'll see to arranging your supplies as well.」

0x002A2B.en: 「Thank you. If I may get right to it,@ I have questions about the surface-worlders summoned@ here, and about how they might return home.」

0x002AD6.en: 「Returning you to the surface is possible, but the priests@ who cast the return spell are scattered, so preparations@ will take a while.」

0x002B8D.en: 「At least, it hinges on retaking the capital@ and ending this war. We're also probing why@ summonings spiked, and hunting the summoned...」

0x002C62.en: 「But as things stand, we can't spare hands for that.@ I'm sorry, but you'll have no choice@ but to remain here a while longer.」

0x002D0A.en: 「Until the time comes to return to the surface,@ you're asking us to cooperate with you...?」

0x002D63.en: 「It would be a great help if you would.@ That's the fastest path back to your own world.」

0x002DCE.en: 「For our part, we intend to brush off any sparks@ that fall on us as well, but...」

0x002E34.en: 「General Kirkus! An enemy force has split into three@ and is closing on us fast!」

0x002E9C.en: 「Hmph... a desperate surprise attack,@ or a diversion. Either way, we intercept.@ I'll sortie in the Galguard.」

0x002F63.en: 「That's just how it is when you're fighting to@ reclaim your own homeland, Colonel.」

0x002FBC.en: 「And it's my declaration of resolve, too:@ to drive off the Shutedonias army no matter what@ and bring peace back to Langran.」

0x00305E.en: 「...Understood. We'll join the fight as well.@ To put an end to the war in this land.」

0x0030FA.en: 「The enemy heading our way -@ the Steel Dragon Squadron and I will take them on.」

0x003150.en: 「The top brass sorties himself? That's some nerve.」

0x00318D.en: 「That Elemental's pretty slick, huh.@ It's even got four arms.」

0x003217.en: 「The Galguard's specs come close to a Machine God's...@ but its design is closer to Cybuster than to my own machine.」

0x003327.en: 「Hey! Don't lump me in with the boys!」

0x0033B7.en: (Steel Dragon Squadron... let me see that power up close.)

0x0033FA.en: 「Enemy incoming! Straight in from one o'clock!@ Four of them!」

0x00344E.en: 「Heh, got off to a late start.@ But thanks to that, I've got some fine prey.」

0x0034B6.en: 「The hell's that... doesn't look like an Elemental.@ A surface machine?」

0x00350F.en: 「But there's no matching data on it!」

0x00354F.en: 「Yo.@ You lot are the Steel Dragon Squadron, right? Heard about you.」

0x0035C7.en: 「Yeah, name's Chien Argent.@ One of the <Boosted Children>.」

0x00365A.en: 「Yeah. But don't go lumping me in with@ small fry like Bronzo 28 or 27.」

0x0036C2.en: 「I'm Argent Class...@ Now that Aurum 1's dead,@ I'm the number one Boosted Child.」

0x003764.en: 「Arado and the others said there were@ other survivors, but...」

0x0037B7.en: 「Don't tell me they were put through the <Rimacon> too...!?」

0x0037F9.en: 「Hey now, don't lump me in with those junkies.@ This line of work just suits me.」

0x003870.en: 「Besides, seems like there's better money in this world.@ And if my mark's you lot, all the better.」

0x0038F0.en: 「Who do you belong to?@ You don't look Federation... a Neue DC remnant?」

0x00395A.en: 「Right now I'm hired by the Shutedonias army.@ I've got no plans to tell you my surface affiliation.」

0x0039FF.en: 「Then a Neue DC remnant's fine by me.@ Long as the pay's good, I don't care where.」

0x003A79.en: 「You're a far cry from Arado and the rest...」

0x003AB0.en: 「They're defective goods, plain and simple.@ What a Boosted Child's supposed to be,@ that's me.」

0x003B3A.en: 「Like I care!@ You want to pick a fight with us,@ we'll take you on!」

0x003BA3.en: 「Heh... take down the Steel Dragon Squadron,@ and even back on the surface we're winners.」

0x003C0E.en: 「Sorry to the others, but the glory's mine.@ You lot get to be the losers.@ So brace yourselves!」

0x003C98.en: 「Tch, he's a handful!@ But I've got no intention of being anyone's loser!」

0x003D03.en: 「Enemy signals in the combat zone have vanished.@ The other enemy units seem to be withdrawing too.」

0x003D6E.en: 「So the enemy's real aim was a diversion...?」

0x003D9F.en: 「That kid from before...@ big talk, then he cleared out just like that.」

0x003E07.en: 「Didn't seem like Federation@ or a Neue DC remnant, either...」

0x003E66.en: 「His machine was a new-model Lion series.@ Isurugi's involved, or else...」

0x003F02.en: 「I've heard that name in passing, but... what is it?」

0x003F48.en: 「An organization under the Federation president's direct control.@ Supposedly they develop and test new weapons.」

0x003FBC.en: 「And their base of operations is Grand Christmas...@ the place once known as Aidoneus Island.」

0x004055.en: 「The surrounding waters are blockaded, and@　the whole island's cloaked in a special shade,@　so even satellite seekers can't see it, they say.」

0x004109.en: 「...I've heard all kinds of shady rumors.」

0x00413A.en: （My old man's... the former <Divine Crusaders>@　headquarters, reduced to that...）

0x0041B0.en: 「Either way, stuck here in La Gias,@　there's no way to look into it.」

0x004206.en: 「...General Kirkus, may I have a word?」

0x004240.en: 「If you have something to say, save it for later.@　We press on and pursue the retreating enemy.」

0x0042B7.en: 「We must sweep the Shtednias army from Trojan@　and prove our strength. The sooner we do,@　the sooner this war with them ends.」

0x004387.en: 「Colonel Lefina, I ask for your continued aid.」

0x004407.en: 「You picked a fight with us, and you think@　you'll walk away clean? Don't count on it!」

0x00445D.en: 「Ohh, scary. Old hags sure got some bite.」

0x004485.en: 「Who are you calling a hag!@　Don't get cocky, you little brat!!」

0x0044E1.en: 「That machine of yours, is that a Lion series!?」

0x00452D.en: 「That's right! This is a Kerberion, so@ burn it into your memory!」

0x004583.en: 「Not that it matters, since you die here!」

0x0045CC.en: 「You're the captain of that ATX Team, aren't you?@　Kyosuke Nanbu, right?」

0x004631.en: 「And if you confirm that, then what?」

0x00465F.en: 「The ATX Team is prime game!@　Bag you, and the pay's real good!」

0x0046C4.en: 「If you're willing to trade your life for it,@　then come and get me...!」

0x00472C.en: 「Take down the DC leader's daughter, and@　you make yourself a name!」

0x00478B.en: 「I've got no plans to be your stepping stone!」

0x00483F.en: 「Never heard of you... Well, a member of the@　Steel Dragon Squadron's a nice prize.」

0x0048A4.en: 「I know all about it - in this world, a@　Machine God's the real jackpot!」

0x0048FD.en: 「To think even the likes of them have been@　summoned here...!」

0x004943.en: 「Not as much as a <Machine God>, but bagging@　a <Mech-armor> pays well too.」

0x0049DA.en: 「Well, well, well - the supreme commander of@　Langran! Killing him is more than just good pay!」

0x004A5A.en: 「With ambitions that low, don't imagine@　you'll ever take my head.」
